title: Brand toolkit
slide_intent: Distinguish what a designer should repeat consistently from what can change for the subject. A system can accommodate new content while retaining familiar identifiers.
strategic_value: Frontline AIDS can preserve recognition through the logo, palette and typefaces while allowing typography, photographs and illustrations to vary.
demonstration: Six specimens form two columns. Logo and symbol, colour palette and typefaces sit above the fixed-assets caption. Typography, photography and illustration sit above the flexible-assets caption.
practical_value: When creating a new piece, identify which choices have fixed rules and where adaptation is encouraged.

content_islands.name: Introduction
content_islands.spec: Place the navigation rail and introductory paragraph to the left of the toolkit.

content_islands.name: Fixed specimens
content_islands.spec: Group the logo, palette and typefaces in a single labeled column, with guide page references and the fixed-assets note.

content_islands.name: Flexible specimens
content_islands.spec: Mirror the row structure for typography, photography and illustration. Add the flexible-assets note beneath that column.
